channel.title: Proxly Updates
channel.description: Updates for Proxly - Smart Browser Chooser

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
• **Template Mode**: Use simple variables like `{host}`, `{path}`, `{query:param}`, and `{pathComponent:index}` to redirect URLs
  • **JavaScript Mode**: Write custom transformation logic with full JavaScript support in a sandboxed environment
  • **Live Preview**: See your transformations in action with real-time validation and examples
  • **Use Cases**: Redirect to alternative front-ends (e.g., Twitter → Nitter), remove tracking parameters, or create custom URL rewrites
  • **Create & Configure**: Set up multiple Safari profiles with custom names and SF Symbol icons
  • **Smart Window Routing**: Automatically route URLs to specific Safari windows based on your rules
  • **Seamless Integration**: Configure Safari profiles just like Chrome or Firefox profiles in your routing rules
  • **Drag & Drop**: Reorder browsers and their profiles in the management view (https://github.com/pawel-mazurkiewicz/proxly-releases/issues/7)
  • **Custom Shortcuts**: Your order determines keyboard shortcuts (1-9) in the selection panel
  • **Profile Reordering**: Arrange profiles within each browser to optimize your workflow
  • **Reset Option**: Easily revert to alphabetical sorting
  • **Supported Apps**: Zoom, Discord, Spotify, Figma, Trello, Linear
  • **Auto-Detection**: Only shows installed applications in the preset picker
  • **Per-Rule Configuration**: Enable native app routing on any rule
  • **Smart Fallback**: Automatically falls back to browser if transformation fails
  • **Query String Matching**: URL processor now includes query parameters in pattern matching for more precise rules (Example: transforming these hideous MS Teams links to something usable - they contain proper link in their query section)
  • Improved browser profile data persistence during cold launches
  • Fixed critical crash when matching wildcard host patterns (e.g., `*.slack.com`) against apex domains
  • Better Duplicate Detection Rule imports now consider transformation logic to prevent false duplicates
  • Fixed onboarding window management to prevent "ghost" windows (https://github.com/pawel-mazurkiewicz/proxly-releases/issues/9)
